The anode-free full cell uses a presodiated pyrite (FeS2) cathode. 

The pyrite cathode is presodiated prior to cell assembly. 

The cathode capacity assumed for its energy density is 335 mAh/g, corresponding to a Na1.5FeS2 stoichiometry.

expect: pyrite (FeS2), presodiated before assembly (p5.L29-41); Na1.5FeS2 stoichiometry, an FeS2 capacity of 335 mAh/g (p5.L52-53)
question: What cathode does the anode-free full cell use, how is it prepared so that the cell contains no sodium metal on assembly, and what cathode capacity was assumed for its energy density?
